title: Tesla Vehicle Safety Report (quarterly Autopilot vs non-Autopilot crash rates)
methodology: Tesla counts crashes in which Autopilot was deactivated within 5 seconds before impact, and all crashes where an airbag or other active restraint deployed (about 12 mph or above); miles from fleet telemetry; no fault attribution. January 2023 restatement removed events without restraint deployment, duplicates and invalid mileage records, and restated all prior quarters including the US baseline.
caveats: 'Autopilot' covers Autopilot and FSD (Beta/Supervised) combined. Geography not stated. US baseline is NHTSA/FHWA data for the year named in each quarter's text, not a matched comparison. Live page tesla.com/VehicleSafetyReport now redirects to tesla.com/fsd/safety.
locator: Section 'Miles Driven Per One Accident', one paragraph per quarter ('In the Nth quarter, we recorded one crash for every ...'); 'Methodology' paragraph

title: Full Self-Driving (Supervised) Vehicle Safety Report
date_range: rolling 12 months; window end not stated
methodology: Collision = event meeting 49 CFR 563.5: any non-reversible restraint deployed ('major') or delta-V >= 8 km/h within 150 ms without deployment ('minor'). FSD (Supervised) counted as engaged if active at any point within 5 s before the collision. No fault attribution. Rolling 12-month aggregation updated quarterly (page FAQ). US average = FHWA VMT / CISS vehicles-in-crashes (Table 3); highway/minor US splits use ratios from Tesla's manual fleet.
caveats: Tesla does not print the 12-month window's end date; the quarter is our assignment from the update timing. Region 'North America' per the page's dropdown; report excludes China. Values flagged is_estimated=true by Tesla are not copied except where noted.
locator: Page script (Drupal footer JS) variable 'miles_per_collision_all_data', rows with road_class 'All Road Classes' and region 'North America'; mileage counter constants 'totalMilesStart' and 'startEpochTime' in the same script
